author: The Infographics Show
description:
They look like lumps of burnt coal, but inside is a lost library from 2,000 years ago.

The Herculaneum Scrolls were sealed when Mount Vesuvius erupted, carbonizing entire books into fragile black blocks. Any attempt to open them destroyed them.
For centuries, they were completely unreadable. A mystery no one could solve.

Until now!
With high-resolution X-rays and AI, scientists can digitally “unroll” the scrolls and detect ink that’s invisible to the human eye. Words hidden for millennia are finally being revealed.

What they’re finding is extraordinary. Ancient Greek philosophy, lost texts, and knowledge that hasn’t been seen since the Roman Empire.

CHAPTERS:
0:00 - Discovery of the Scrolls
0:37 - Vesuvius, Pompeii, and Herculaneum
1:39 - Why the Scrolls Were Impossible to Read
2:55 - How AI Made Reading Them Possible
4:49 - The Vesuvius Challenge
6:06 - Luke Farritor’s Breakthrough
9:06 - What the Scrolls Actually Say
12:25 - What We Might Discover Next

Narrated by: Josh Risser
title: AI Just Decoded the 'Unreadable' Herculaneum Scrolls. The Buried Library
